subject: youtube.operating_rules
summary: The recovered Council strategy treats long-form YouTube as the main revenue/library destination, Shorts as discovery and hook testing, and TikTok/Reels/Facebook as deliberate platform-specific redistribution rather than automatic copy-paste.

funnel.youtube_shorts: discovery and hook laboratory; short views alone do not define success
funnel.tiktok_reels_facebook: platform-specific cuts and redistribution, not automatic duplication

anti_slop_rules: no video without a clear thesis or question
keep FACT / INFERENCE / SPECULATION distinct where relevant
no AI shot solely as filler
human voice remains core identity unless deliberately tested
do not create a new platform account without a defined funnel role
do not scale before three-video pilot and review
